  director = 'Various (showrunner: M. Raven Metzner)',
  `cast` = 'Finn Jones as Danny Rand / Iron Fist, Jessica Henwick as Colleen Wing, Sacha Dhawan as Davos / Steel Serpent, Alice Eve as Mary Walker / Typhoid Mary, Simone Missick as Misty Knight, Tom Pelphrey as Ward Meachum',
  tagline = 'The fist passes to a new champion. A redemption story that proved the doubters wrong.',
  description = 'Iron Fist Season 2 follows Danny Rand as he faces his former brother Davos, who steals the Iron Fist power, while a mysterious woman named Mary Walker complicates matters. The season culminates in a surprising transfer of power.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/iron-fist-s2-featured-UeL6miQnFNaKLnf3DozTsE.webp',

Season 2 cards benefit from the show''s improved reception and the introduction of popular characters like Typhoid Mary and the Daughters of the Dragon team-up. Alice Eve as Mary Walker cards have crossover appeal, and Colleen Wing wielding the Iron Fist is a unique collectible moment.',
  keyCards = '- **2019 Upper Deck Marvel Annual Iron Fist S2** — Improved season, improved card value, $3-12
- **2019 Marvel Premier Colleen Wing Iron Fist** — Colleen as the new Iron Fist, unique card, $8-20
- **2019 Marvel Annual Typhoid Mary/Alice Eve** — Popular actress debut, $5-15',
  content = '## The Redemption Season

Iron Fist Season 2 is a case study in how to fix a struggling show. New showrunner M. Raven Metzner trimmed the episode count to 10, tightened the fight choreography, and gave the supporting cast room to shine. The result was a dramatically improved show that left fans wanting more.

## Colleen Wing Takes the Fist

The season''s boldest move was transferring the Iron Fist power to Colleen Wing. Jessica Henwick''s Colleen had been the best part of the franchise from day one, and seeing her wield the glowing fist in the finale was a triumphant moment that honored both the character and the audience.

## Daughters of the Dragon

Colleen Wing and Misty Knight''s team-up gave fans the Daughters of the Dragon partnership from the comics. Their chemistry was electric, and their fight scenes together were the best action the Iron Fist franchise ever produced.

## Fun Facts

- The season was reduced to 10 episodes specifically to address pacing complaints
- Finn Jones trained for months longer than Season 1, and the improved choreography shows
- Alice Eve''s Typhoid Mary was planned to appear in future seasons that were cancelled
- The final scene teasing Danny with guns was inspired by the Immortal Iron Fist comics',
  metaDescription = 'Iron Fist Season 2 (2018) guide — the redemption season, Colleen Wing spotlight, Daughters of the Dragon, trading card values, and why cancellation came too soon.',
  keywords = 'iron fist season 2, colleen wing, typhoid mary, daughters of the dragon, netflix marvel, finn jones, marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Iron Fist Colleen Wing cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Iron Fist Season 2 better than Season 1?","answer":"Yes, significantly. Season 2 received much better reviews with improved fight choreography, tighter pacing (10 episodes vs 13), and stronger character development."},{"question":"Does Colleen Wing become the Iron Fist?","answer":"Yes, in a surprising twist, the Iron Fist power transfers to Colleen Wing by the end of Season 2, making her the new Iron Fist champion."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'iron-fist-season-2-2018'
